title: Ops Bento: curated admin utilities shelf + rule-driven task executor
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight catalog ("Ops Bento") of vetted admin utilities (idempotent commandlets, repair steps, checks) and a rule-driven task executor that maps incidents/alerts to safe, parameterized task sequences. Goal: shorten median time-to-remediate for common infra issues while preserving auditability, RBAC, and dry-run safety.
spec: High-level: 1) Ops Bento catalog (YAML-based manifest per utility) with metadata (purpose, inputs, outputs, required perms, idempotency level, estimated cost). 2) Task executor service that ingests rule triggers (alert tags / incident playbook name) and composes ordered tasks from the catalog. 3) Safety layer: dry-run mode, permission checks, confirm step gates for privileged actions, automatic rollback steps. 4) Telemetry: per-task timing, success/failure reasons, tokenized audit trail pushed to activity-log and traced through console.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog can store and serve at least 40 curated utilities with metadata and example inputs
Executor can run a 3-step composed task sequence end-to-end in staging with dry-run and real-run modes
Audit log entries created for all non-dry runs that include user, inputs, resolution outcome, and linked incident ID
RBAC enforcement integrated: users without ops-run role cannot execute privileged utilities (returns 403)
Operator console shows per-task latency and failure rate for sequences executed in last 7 days
implementation_tasks: Define catalog schema (YAML) and validation rules + document examples
Build catalog storage: small service + REST endpoints; store manifests in s3 with index in DynamoDB
Implement executor service skeleton: ingest rule triggers, lookup catalog, assemble sequence
Add safety primitives: dry-run, confirm-gate, automatic rollback stub
Integrate with authz service to enforce ops-run, admin roles
Emit telemetry: task.start/task.end events to telemetry-ingest; wire basic Grafana dashboard panels
Write 10 initial utilities: disk-pressure-check, prefix-cache-warm, model-serve-cache-clear, node-drain-safe, rolling-restart-lite
E2E tests: unit + integration test harness; record golden artifacts for offline review
Prepare runbook for SREs: how to add utilities, how to create rules, incident playbook examples
Security review and threat model signoff
migration_plan: Phase 1 (staging): runbook authoring + manual trigger only; Phase 2 (canary): wire a low-risk alert channel (test-alerts) to invoke non-privileged sequences; Phase 3 (production): enable for telemetry-identified high-frequency low-risk incidents with canary rollouts and auto-disable if failure rate > 5% over 1h.
telemetry_and_alerting: Emit structured events: ops_bento.task.start, .task.end, .task.error with fields (task_key, sequence_id, initiator, dry_run). Dashboard panels: task latency histogram, error-rate by task_key, sequences-per-alert. Pager rule: if sequence error-rate > 10% over 30m for production rules, page SRE on-call.
